subject: Hey Baby!
author: ichienkai
body:
Its good to see you posting on here Foxy!  Even if its a reply to certain accusations that can't be true.... Bootleg is too honest for his own good!  If he'd have been with you on Saturday night he'd have the Burner Meet Up thing and he did say he wanted to be honest with that so unlucky Boot lol

We don't need to see your efforts to break us up on here anyway, keep it in the races and i'll keep on crashing for you "Bootylicious" hahaha

To be fair to him Foxy he was a bit hungover last night and i think Eezo took advantage of the situation to bust him up vertically - Good races though Eezo.... we all seemed to get the better of Stinky too which doesnt always happen! (**Stinky's head width slowly expands**)

Anyhow i'm off for a few races so i'll see you out on the tracks very soon if not later!!!
